newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian court releases Mobutu son on bail.
newsitem.headline: Belgian court releases Mobutu son on bail.

text.p: A Belgian court on Friday released a son of Zaire's former leader Mobutu Sese Seko from detention on fraud charges after bail was set at 3.8 million Belgian francs ($108,000), Belga news agency said.
Fangbi Mobutu Ndokula, 23, is alleged to have tried to swindle a Belgian company out of between three and four million francs ($84,000 to $112,000) with a false cheque.
Bail of three million francs had been refused earlier in the week at the request of the Brussels prosecutor's office.
